item.title: AgentScope's Event Log in Production: One KV Table, 14x Write Amplification, and the 23-Second Toll
item.description: AgentScope Java's default EVENT_LOG session mode: the journal is append-only and never compacted. Upstream measured 14-17x write amplification and O(n²) read degradation; I reproduced it locally across three backends and wrote the production playbook.
